gbm_population_evidence.quote: Tissue-based diagnosis of recurrent glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype by a neuropathologist
Novel Indenoisoquinolone CMYC/TOPOISOMERASE 1 Inhibitor (LMP744) in Recurrent Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: All patients will receive LMP744 as the interventional drug along with surgery for a biopsy and a second surgery for either resection or an additional biopsy to compare the tissue pre vs. post-drug treatment.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Tissue-based diagnosis of recurrent glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype by a neuropathologist

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Tissue, CSF, and plasma will be collected during the post-treatment surgical intervention for molecular analysis.
To assess the pharmacologic (PK/PD) response by exploring molecular and metabolic changes in pre- versus posttreatment glioblastoma tissue following administration of LMP744.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: A comparative pharmacodynamic analysis will be conducted on the pre- and post-treatment tissue to evaluate the biological response to LMP744 and correlate pharmacodynamic changes with clinical outcomes.
Evaluating changes in these markers will provide insight into the pharmacodynamic effects of LMP744 at the molecular level.

role_evidence.quote: All patients will receive LMP744 as the interventional drug

source_quote.quote: Tissue-based diagnosis of recurrent glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype by a neuropathologist

coder_notes: tumour_pk_planned coded yes: record plans 'pharmacologic (PK/PD)' assessment in pre/post glioblastoma tissue, with tissue and CSF collected after dosing; however, it does not explicitly state measurement of LMP744 concentration (described as molecular/metabolic changes), so 'no' or 'unclear' are defensible alternatives. Pharmacodynamic transcriptomic/proteomic markers (DNA damage response, cell cycle) are unspecified and not listed as biomarkers. IDH-wildtype is a diagnostic criterion only.
